life_event: Born in Tulsa, Oklahoma. 1944 Zani’s mother and father get divorced.
Enrolled in the University of Texas.

Is hired as a clerical assistant in the main library at the University of Texas. Sept, 1966 Is promoted to library assistant 1966 Ran for student-body president and received 924 votes, finishing third.

Zani purchases a .357 Ruger Blackhawk from Oshman’s Sporting Goods in Austin. 06/01/1967 Is promoted to translator in the archives section of the UT library. Married Irma Serrano Reyes in Mexico City. He adopted her two children and they
later had two children of their own.
Joined the U.S. Marine’s officer training program. Used a .357 Ruger to kill his first victim, George Vizard (WM, 73) at his convenience
store job in Austin, Texas.
Backed out of his commitment to the Marines and receives an honorably discharge. July, 1974 Murdered his mother in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Body never found.
Zani bought a house in south Texas. Moved to Buffalo, Missouri. Neighbors called the police several times regarding Zani’s
erratic behavior.
Wrote threatening letters to President Carter and his daughter Amy. February, 1979 Sold his house in Buffalo at a loss and left town
Killed his mother, Gladys Zani (WF, 56), in her Tulsa home.
Began living in a motel in San Antonio with his family for two months.
Zani shot real estate agent Julius Alfred Dess (WM, 73) in Corpus Christi, Texas. He was arrested in Acapulco, Mexico for aggravated robbery and assault on his mother
in-law.
He bought a .25 caliber handgun in Texas.
He was arrested for credit card theft in Austin, Texas.
He was convicted of credit card theft.
He was indicted by a grand jury for the murder of Julius Dess.
Trial for the murder of George Vizard begins.
Convicted of the murder of George Vizard and sentenced to 99 years in prison.
He was convicted of second-degree murder of his mother.
Jury selection begins in the retrial of his conviction for murdering his mother. Jury convicts Zani of second-degree murder of his mother. Zani receives a sentence of
99 years.
Zani is returned to Texas to serve his prison sentence for the murder of George Vizard.
The murder conviction of his mother was overturned in Tulsa, Oklahoma
